page.overview:
Who is Crasher Wake?

Crasher Wake serves as the Gym Leader at the Pastoria City Gym. His actual name is unknown; the name Crasher Wake is likely just a title that he inherited. Wake specializes in -type Pokémon, and holds the Fen Badge for the trainers that defeat him.

Crasher Wake is a middle-aged man, who has a patch of black hair and beard.

Crasher Wake doesn't wear a shirt, but he wears orange/blue bracers and boots. His blue pants with orange outlines that have black appendages on his legs, which resemble Swampert's appearance. He also wears a blue mask with white wings-like appendages. Crasher Wake is a very strong-built man.

Prior to the Cataclysm, Crasher Wake wears a space suit.
